thread:
Ana: Heads-up: I opened PR #487 to reorg the Dedicated Capacity handbook. Main goals: (1) move 'isolation' into a dedicated section, (2) add a migration subsection for autoscale v2, (3) include a short SDK snippet for tenant-labeling, and (4) fix broken SLA matrix link. Need 2 reviewers and someone to sanity-check snippets. PTAL? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/487

Mike L: On it. Can you drop a checklist of what changed? I'll do link sanity and quick grammar pass.

Ana: Quick checklist: file moves (docs/dedicated/isolation.md -> docs/dedicated/isolation/index.md), new migration page docs/dedicated/autoscale-migration.md, added SDK snippet to docs/dedicated/examples/tenant-labels.md, updated sla-table.md link to /handbook/sla-matrix. Also added YAML example of scale policy.

Jamal: I can write the migration blurb — will add small compatibility matrix for old->new autoscale fields. Also, pinging @Sasha for the YAML example because she contributed the sim.

Sasha: @Jamal happy to add the YAML. Also noticed our SDK snippet uses old client import path. I'll update to the new unified SDK.

docs-bot: PR 487 opened by Ana — reviewers requested: Mike L, Jamal, Sasha. CI: docs-lint ⏳, linkcheck failed (2 broken anchors).

Mike L: I'll take the linkcheck failures. Which anchors? Looks like 'isolation-sla' anchor changed.

Ana: Yes - anchors moved when I split the section. Proposed solution: add previous anchors with HTML redirects (<!-- legacy-anchor: isolation-sla -->) and update crossrefs. Prefer to keep backward compat for published links.

Jamal: For the migration guide: propose example mapping table + code snippet showing autoscale policy v1 -> v2. Example: `max_replicas` -> `max_capacity` and `min_replicas` -> `min_capacity`. Will also include a note about cooldown semantics.

Ana: Great. Sasha can you replace SDK snippet with this JS example? ```js
import {Redwood} from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY})
await client.dedicated.provision({tenant: 'acme', labels: ['team:web'], scalePolicy: {min:1, max:4}})
```

Sasha: LGTM, will update to TypeScript variant and add inline comment about eventual consistency of tenant labeling.

Mike L: :thumbsup: I'll re-run linkcheck after anchors are added. Also suggest adding a short note in the SLA doc about eviction preemption window.

Ana: Noted. I'll add a one-liner in SLA table: 'Eviction preemption window: 5 min (typical) — consult dedicated SLA page for variation.'

Jamal: If everyone OK, I'll approve after the migration matrix lands. ETA 2 hours.

Sasha: I'll push TS snippet in a follow-up commit and ping when ready.

Ana: Thanks all — merging once CI passes and links verified. If anyone wants to do a last read, pls review before 1700 PT. /cc docs-bot to remind tomorrow if it's still open.
